title: P0.69: Metacognitive Discernment Frame + Genesis Attractor Filter
description: IABV must have a discernment organ before acting. Each datum must pass through a filter that determines origin, reliability, bias, contradictions, grounding, attractors, candidate action, and risk of acting without sufficient evidence.
root_cause: System lacked a unified pre-action discernment contract. Existing services (OSES, ExperimentLab, AdaptiveWeightLayer, PerceptionSnapshot) each held fragments but no service combined them into a coherent frame that could answer: source, confidence, contradictions, bias, and why this action is reasonable.
